outcome: neurodevelopmental outcomes at 2 years of age
cohort: 221 infants born before 32 weeks gestational age (GA) from 1999 to 2015
finding: High NfL levels during the first weeks of life were associated with ROP and poor neurodevelopmental outcomes at 2 years of age.
mod_finding: In a binary logistic regression model adjusted for GA at birth, birth weight SD score, Apgar status at 5 minutes, and mode of delivery, the NfL AUC at weeks 2 to 4 was independently associated with any ROP.
